text:
Talia Nguyen: Quick FYI converting from contractor -> full time. Hiring manager requests a band correction and a small sign-on. Need approvals and a backpay plan because they'd like FTE start aligned with last contractor day.
Priya Kapoor: What's the requested band and amounts? Any equity involved? :clipboard:
Talia Nguyen: Manager proposes IC4 -> IC5 provisional, $4,000 one-time sign-on, and 2,000 RSU grant prorated to 9 months. There's also a requested retroactive pay adjustment of $2,500 for the contractor period to match full-time rate.
Evan Brooks: Retro pay + sign-on affects payroll/tax. @Payroll Ops and @Benefits Team FYI: benefits eligibility start date depends on the official FTE start. Candidate wants FTE start = 2026-07-01 (last contractor invoice period ends 06-30). If we backdate, benefits kick in earlier.
Payroll Ops: We can process a one-time retroactive payment but need approvals: comp committee + finance lead. Also need the invoice vs payroll treatment decision. Manual payroll entry required; provide Workday fields.
Benefits Team: If official start is 07-01 we can enroll candidate for benefits effective 07-01 with the next enrollment cycle. Backdating earlier than invoice dates requires HR director sign-off for benefit eligibility exceptions.
Priya Kapoor: Routing checklist I'm adding:
```
- Band correction form (IC4 -> IC5 provisional)
- Comp Committee approval
- Retro pay approval and tax treatment
- Sign-on approval ($4k)
- Equity grant terms and proration
- Benefits start date exception if needed
- Workday + payroll entries
```
hr-ops-bot: Request 3620012345 created. Required approvals: Comp Committee, Legal Team (equity terms), Payroll Ops, Benefits Team. Deadline 72h.
Talia Nguyen: Manager justification uploaded: contractor performed at IC5 scope, recruiter market comps attached, manager requests provisional status and 9-month review.
Comp Committee: Can we see market data and reason for provisional not permanent? Need manager note on performance and timeline for review.
Talia Nguyen: Uploaded manager note: temporary assignment initially mis-leveled; will be reviewed after 9 months with formal calibration.
Comp Committee: Approved provisional IC5 for 9 months. Retro pay and sign-on require payroll confirmation and tax guidance. Voting: majority approve.
Legal Team: Equity grant for converted contractor needs legal review for contractor to employee RSU eligibility and vesting start date. Drafting grant language; check for clawback triggers given retro pay.
Payroll Ops: Confirmed manual one-time payment feasible. Need to know how to code retro pay: invoice_adj=false, payroll_adjust=true, amount=2500, tax_withheld=true. Provide manager cost center and invoice code.
Benefits Team: For benefits eligibility to begin 07-01 we need FTE status effective 07-01. If team wants coverage to start 06-15 we'll need HR director exception and to handle premiums retroactively.
Priya Kapoor: Manager provided cost center ENG-MLE and invoice code ENG-FT-778. Manager prefers benefits start 07-01 and no retro coverage for medical (candidate ok with that). Everything else good.
hr-ops-bot: Approvals update: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=pending, Payroll Ops=pending, Benefits Team=acknowledged.
Legal Team: Reviewed RSU grant. Approved legal terms with vesting schedule prorated to hire date 2026-07-01. Clawback clause standard for sign-on and retro pay.
Payroll Ops: With approvals we can process retro pay 2500 in next payroll cycle and one-time sign-on 4000. Workday fields to set:
```
- job_profile_band=IC5_provisional
- salary_effective_date=2026-07-01
- one_time_signon=4000
- retro_one_time=2500
- cost_center=ENG-MLE
- invoice_code=ENG-FT-778
```
Talia Nguyen: Thanks team. I'll confirm with the candidate that official FTE start is 2026-07-01, sign-on and retro pay will be processed as above, and RSU grant details will follow. Candidate acceptance window 72h.
Priya Kapoor: I'll draft the offer addendum and Workday entry note. Once candidate signs, payroll ops will queue payments and benefits will enroll Talia effective 07-01.
Evan Brooks: Flagging onboarding to schedule equipment and orientation for 07-01. Also note to People Ops to set 9-month calibration reminder.
Talia Nguyen: Closing loop: candidate preferred Redwood and accepts provisional band; will sign within the window. Will update when signed and when payroll confirms scheduling. :white_check_mark:
